content: {"like":["Values high‑quality visual and audio production, especially CGI and transfer quality; appreciates detailed bonus features such as commentaries, interviews, and galleries; enjoys well‑executed creature design and evolution across sequels; favors strong chemistry among main characters and entertaining, well‑crafted performances; prefers well‑packaged releases with durable, non‑scratching sleeves or book‑style cases."],"dislike":["Dislikes when a film or series loses its original charm or deviates from the source material; finds uninspired or derivative monster designs and over‑used tropes off‑putting; criticizes poor pacing, weak storytelling, and lack of meaningful character development; is frustrated by confusing menu navigation, incorrect episode order, and bulky packaging; rejects releases that lack essential bonus content or have inconsistent transfer quality."]}
